tools.name: search-lab-tests
tools.description: Search the JustLabs catalog of tests AND panels by test name, condition (e.g. menopause, gout, anemia), category, or biomarker. Use only product terms; do not include names, contact details, symptoms, or personal lab results. Prices are per test; one $18 lab & physician order fee is added once per o

tools.name: get-test-details
tools.description: Get full details for a specific lab test or panel by its ID. Returns pricing, biomarkers (or included tests for a panel), preparation instructions, and turnaround time.

tools.name: get-test-panels
tools.description: Get available test panels and compare panel base prices with their included tests bought separately. One $18 lab & physician order fee applies once per order.

tools.name: get-pricing
tools.description: Get the exact all-in price for one or more JustLabs test or panel IDs: each item's price, the single $18 per-order lab & physician fee (charged once per order), and the total — the same amount checkout charges. Pass an optional 2-letter US state to check whether the order can be placed there.

tools.name: find-draw-sites
tools.description: Find Quest Diagnostics patient service centers (blood-draw sites) near a 5-digit US ZIP code where a JustLabs order can be collected: site code, address, distance, hours, walk-ins and a booking link, optionally with the next open appointment times. Send only a ZIP code — never a street address, name

tools.description: Typical reference ranges for a lab marker (e.g. TSH, ferritin, LDL cholesterol, vitamin D), optionally by sex and age, with unit, source and the JustLabs test that measures it. tools.name: compare-provider
tools.description: How JustLabs compares with another lab-testing provider (e.g. everlywell, testwell, quest, labcorp): a short verdict, side-by-side facts with sources, where each one is the better choice, FAQs and a link to the full comparison page. Product terms only.

tools.description: Suggest JustLabs panels and tests for health goals (e.g. energy, heart health, fertility) and/or symptoms (e.g. fatigue, hair loss), each with a one-line reason, price, all-in price and link, plus the JustLabs guide pages the suggestion is based on. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get-guide · Private data: search-lab-tests, find-draw-sites, recommend-tests · Public sink: find-draw-sites, lookup-reference-range.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get-guide · Private data: search-lab-tests, find-draw-sites, recommend-tests · Public sink: find-draw-sites, lookup-reference-range

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
